title: With those born with natural talents, it feels as if they ex…

sents.en: With those born with natural talents, it feels as if they excel without really trying.
sents.cn: 对于那些天生拥有才华的人，感觉他们不怎么努力就能出类拔萃。

sents.en: But what about those of us who don·t have a natural talent?
sents.cn: 但我们这些没有天赋的人呢？

sents.en: We·ve been told all our lives that if you work hard, you too can succeed.
sents.cn: 我们一生都被教导：只要努力，你也能成功。

sents.en: But with the release of Angela Duckworth·s Grit, we are given a new key to success.
sents.cn: 但随着安杰拉∙达克沃思《坚毅》一书的出版，我们获得了成功的一把新钥匙。

sents.en: ·As much as talent counts, effort counts twice,· says Duckworth in Grit.
sents.cn: “无论才华有多重要，努力的分量都要加倍，”达克沃思在《坚毅》中说。

sents.en: She introduces a new concept that talent may be overrated, and if you want real success, what you need is grit the perfect combination of passion and persistence.
sents.cn: 她提出一个新观点：才华可能被高估了；如果你想要真正的成功，你需要的是“坚毅”——激情与坚持的完美结合。

sents.en: Even if you have natural talent it·s nothing without grit.
sents.cn: 即便你天生有才，没有坚毅也一文不值。

sents.en: Duckworth says grit is the difference between success and failure.
sents.cn: 达克沃思说，坚毅是成功与失败之间的差别。

sents.en: A person who has grit is more likely to succeed than a person who does not.
sents.cn: 有坚毅的人比没有坚毅的人更可能成功。

sents.en: When we think about attaining success · whether it·s landing that job or learning that new skill · our thoughts are immediately burdened by all the things we must first learn.
sents.cn: 当我们想到要取得成功——无论是得到那份工作还是学会那项新技能——我们的思绪立刻被必须先学会的种种事情所重压。

sents.en: If you want that new job, you have to learn the job skills, then the interview skills, then the dress part · and you must be perfect at all of them.
sents.cn: 如果你想要那份新工作，你得先学工作技能，再学面试技巧，还要学会穿衣打扮——而且必须样样精通。

sents.en: Grit is different because it tells us that perfection isn ·t the goal.
sents.cn: 坚毅的不同之处在于，它告诉我们：完美并非目标。

sents.en: Grit lifts the unreasonable expectations off our shoulders.
sents.cn: 坚毅把不合理的期待从我们肩头卸下。

sents.en: Grit tells us that the door is open wider than we first thought possible.
sents.cn: 坚毅告诉我们，门开得比我们起初以为的更宽。

sents.en: Grit allows us to redefine our goals.
sents.cn: 坚毅让我们重新定义目标。

sents.en: Think about it: what·s something you·ve always wanted to do, but gave up because you ·don·t have the skills for it·?
sents.cn: 想一想：有什么事是你一直想做，却因为“没有相应技能”而放弃的？

sents.en: What·s something you love but aren·t good at?
sents.cn: 有什么事是你喜爱却不擅长的？

sents.en: The real workings of grit are to have sustainable passion and continue to try.
sents.cn: 坚毅真正的作用，在于拥有持续的激情并不断尝试。

sents.en: Effort means more than your natural ability.
sents.cn: 努力比你的天赋更重要。

sents.en: Even if you haven·t mastered a skill, grit tells you that you can still succeed if you can transform your passion into action.
sents.cn: 即便你尚未掌握某项技能，坚毅告诉你，只要能把激情转化为行动，你仍能成功。

sents.en: In a way, Duckworth is giving new hope to people who have shut the doors on their dreams.
sents.cn: 从某种意义上说，达克沃思正在给那些对自己梦想关上大门的人带来新的希望。

sents.en: She is saying it is possible that you can accomplish anything.
sents.cn: 她是在说，你有可能成就任何事。

sents.en: If at first you fail, then try one more time with grit.
sents.cn: 如果起初失败了，那就带着坚毅再试一次
